description: Implementation of 802.15.4 6LoWPAN fragment handling, including fragment reassembly, cache management, and header processing for IPv6 over IEEE 802.15.4 networks within Zephyr OS.

classes.name: frag_cache
classes.description: Cache structure for reassembling IPv6 packets from fragments, including timer, packet reference, size, tag, and usage flag.

methods.name: ieee802154_6lo_reassemble
methods.description: Main function to handle reassembly of IPv6 packets over IEEE 802.15.4, processing fragmented or unfragmented packets accordingly.
